measurement.compressedTotals: Sum of individually compressed emitted files.
measurement.dynamicClosure: Additional emitted files reachable through dynamic imports, excluding the static closure.
measurement.packageScope: All generated JavaScript chunks, deduplicated by emitted path. Assets are separate.
measurement.runtimeExternals: Import specifiers only. Installed dependency bytes are excluded.
measurement.moduleContributors: Rolldown renderedLength, summed across distinct emitted chunks. Wrapper and compression overhead are not attributed.
measurement.recordedBaseline: Converted pre-change bundle probe sizes and import/module metadata. Gzip level9 and default Brotli quality11. No source regeneration.
